integrations.sous_titre: What Moli can drive: add an integration, set it up, see whether it runs.
integrations.entree: Hue, Zigbee, Tuya, Sonos, Meross…: Moli’s catalogue, each integration set up with a form.
integrations.maison.vide: No integration yet: pick one from the catalogue below.
integrations.maison.ailleurs: Set up in the configuration file or added by its address.
integrations.catalogue.chercher: Search a brand, a model, an integration
integrations.champ_nom_aide: Optional. It prefixes its devices and never changes afterwards.
integrations.secret: kept in the vault, never shown again
integrations.secret_garde: Leave empty: keep the stored value
integrations.avance_aide: Options written as in the configuration file (TOML), for what a field cannot say: lists, tables. The guide alongside describes them.
integrations.erreur.auth: The house code is needed for the integrations.
integrations.erreur.auth_busy: Another code request is in progress.
integrations.erreur.network: Moli does not answer. Check that it is running.
integrations.erreur.unknown_integration: This integration is not in the catalogue.
integrations.erreur.not_addable: This integration is not set up here.
integrations.erreur.invalid_instance: The name may only hold lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
integrations.erreur.invalid_field: A field is too long or holds a forbidden character.
integrations.erreur.invalid_advanced: The advanced settings are not valid TOML.
integrations.erreur.duplicate_instance: This name is taken: choose another one.
integrations.erreur.configuration_locked: The integrations file is damaged: repair it before any change.
integrations.erreur.limit_reached: Too many integrations added here (64 at most).
integrations.erreur.no_vault: No vault: secrets cannot be stored.
integrations.erreur.shutting_down: Moli is stopping: try again after the restart.
integrations.erreur.busy: Moli is busy: try again in a moment.
